caption:
I haven't come anywhere. When you re-read old entries, your brain doesn't just recall the words — it reactivates the feelings. The Forward Read keeps you moving forward.

We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this before you open an old journal.

#journaling #overthinking #anxiety #mentalhealth #arajournals
topic: why re-reading old journal entries makes you feel worse
